content:
**Solar Powered** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Gain more STR and END between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Gain +3 to STR and END between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. | 001D2485 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Gain +2 to STR and END between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. | 001D2484 | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain +1 to STR and END between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. | 0004D8A7 | 

Just like in previous games, the perk only functions while being outdoors.
